dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Not bad at all — in fact, it looks quite sturdy. Every bit as practical as the fortifications our logistics unit has built.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't let this haphazard collection of materials fool you. When combined in just the right way, they can withstand even the most ferocious of enemy onslaughts.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This knowledge comes from precious lessons learned in the heat of battle.
